categories.name: Merged 17+18 Discharge
categories.description: Represents cases discharged through the merged pathway 17+18, advancing the goal of reaching a captured discharge.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative id=17 as specified in the goal model decomposition for goal id=6.

categories.name: Release C Discharge
categories.description: Represents cases discharged via Release C, contributing to achieving captured discharge performance measured against indicators such as post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative id=19, observed in variant V0710 realizing Release C.

categories.name: Release D Discharge
categories.description: Represents cases discharged via Release D, successfully reaching a captured discharge as measured by the discharge criteria.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative id=20, observed in variant V0273 ending in Release D.

categories.name: Release E Discharge
categories.description: Represents cases discharged via Release E, completing the admitted case lifecycle to reach a captured discharge.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative id=21 under the OR decomposition of goal id=6.
